    input clk, reset,
    output [1:0] state
);
    reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;

        if (reset)
            current_state <= 2'b00; // Reset to state 0
        else
            current_state <= next_state; // Transition to next state
    end

    always @(*) begin
        case (current_state)
            2'b00: next_state = 2'b01; // From state 0 to state 1
            2'b01: next_state = 2'b10; // From state 1 to state 2
            2'b10: next_state = 2'b00; // From state 2 to state 0
            default: next_state = 2'b00; // Default to state 0
        endcase
    end

    assign state = current_state; // Output the current state
